# cpanel_apache_handler (Data Source)

Looks up one custom cPanel Apache handler by file extension.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_apache_handler" "example" {
  extension = ".example-handler"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `extension` (String) The file extension handled by Apache. It must begin with a dot.

### Read-Only

- `handler` (String) The Apache handler name.
- `origin` (String) The Apache handler owner reported by cPanel.
